title: Quarterly trajectory playbook for hosted API + model curation
creator: Maya Patel
project: Hosted API + Model Catalog - Q2 Trajectory
description: Goal: produce a repeatable 'trajectory playbook' that maps quarterly OKRs to a three-scenario roadmap for the hosted API + model catalog. The playbook will: (1) define curation lanes (stable, opportunistic, experimental), (2) specify gating & eval criteria for model onboarding and rotation, (3) map rollouts to sprint tranches and canary windows, and (4) align success metrics to unit economics (latency/unit cost) and quality regressions. This ticket coordinates PM, Eng, and Design inputs and produces the finalized playbook doc + a rollout checklist for Q2 model churn.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook doc approved by Eng leads and Design (comments resolved)
Decision matrix mapping N model variants across three lane classifications with explicit rollback thresholds
Canary schedule template (dates + target traffic slabs) and automation hooks (feature-flag, route-level metrics)
Eval gate: standardized prompt set (50 prompts) and failure budget definition for per-model regressions
Stakeholder signoff from Platform Reliability, Applied ML, and Growth on metrics and release windows
tasks: Collect historical latency/cost/quality baselines from Console analytics (ENG request: ADR-2148)
Workshop with Applied ML on gating thresholds and prompt set selection
Design: create roll-out communication templates and dashboard mockups
SRE: define monitoring alerts & automated rollback triggers
Run two internal dry-run canaries using a single opportunistic model variant
Finalize and publish playbook in Confluence and link from Hosted API roadmap
